training.primary_unit: one complete old-drug or target query per optimizer update
training.query_order: each eligible query exactly once per cycle, shuffled within direction and interleaved
training.phase_definition: structural trunk frozen initially; global task encoder, context projections, pocket gate and new readout train; later joint phase is explicit
training.precision: BF16 training with FP32 losses; FP32 ranking validation and TF32 disabled

preflight.structural_baseline: measure original teacher and migrated architecture on identical fixed complexes
preflight.claim: engineering and short-transfer validation only; not a quality benchmark

formal_training_requirements: data audit and real full-width preflight pass
full 1223-complex structural retention baseline and paired comparison
fixed FP32 ranking evaluation and matching old-parent scores
explicit handling or controlled study of holo versus predicted-pocket transfer

selection.requirement: predeclare practical margins and use paired intervals across development windows and seeds before promotion
